provider: Alibaba Cloud OSS — new-user free trial

free_tier.stated: Standard LRS resource plan: 500 GB for 1 month (individual) or 1 TB for 1 month (enterprise), stacking with the 5 GB/month free quota to 505 GB or 1029 GB in the trial month. A separate help.aliyun.com variant of the same document states a different figure.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: unverified: neither the international nor the China free-quota page publishes a per-object cap; the pages name capacity, outbound traffic and API-request quotas.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: unverified: no file-retention period is published; the international page states the unused trial capacity quota does not carry over from one hour to the next.

egress.terms: Outbound data transfer plan: 2 GB for 3 months, combined with the 5 GB monthly free quota to 7 GB/month; paid after that.

tooling: OSS S3-compatible API. Rclone 's3' provider 'Alibaba Cloud (Aliyun) Object Storage System (OSS)'; ossutil; OSS SDKs.
chaining: New-user-only trial; one trial per verified account, with a separate individual and enterprise edition.
limits_note: 1 month; 2 GB (trial) + 5 GB/month outbound traffic; 200,000 API requests for 3 months. A 500 GB store with 7 GB/month of egress is a write-only archive you cannot read back for free.

identity_cost.detail: A valid payment method (credit card, debit card, or PayTM) must stay attached during the trial, and identity verification is required.

reliability_note: Reliable object store; the trial simply expires and billing starts on everything, with an SMS warning at exhaustion.
